Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software, Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Dezvoltare de software personalizat pentru sisteme IT
About the Team Hiring 
 The GRAITEC IT Department is a dynamic, multicultural environment bringing together skilled professionals across Europe and North America. With core expertise in IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, systems administration, cloud technologies, and enterprise applications, the team works closely with all business units to ensure stable, secure, and efficient operations that support the company’s strategic objectives. 
 At GRAITEC, the IT team plays a critical role in enabling business performance, minimizing security risks, and driving automation and digital transformation across the organization. We foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and operational excellence, encouraging initiative, supporting professional development, and empowering our IT professionals to implement solutions that create real, measurable impact across the global organization
 Overview 
 The IT Specialist is responsible for maintaining a reliable, secure, and efficient workplace technology environment while delivering high-quality technical support to employees. This role combines hands-on systems administration responsibilities with advanced end-user support and IT operations activities.
 The successful candidate will have strong experience managing Microsoft technologies, endpoint environments, user administration, and operational support processes. They will act as a trusted IT partner to the business, ensuring system availability, supporting workplace technology initiatives, and driving continuous improvement across IT services.
 This role requires an individual who can work effectively in both traditional infrastructure environments and modern cloud-first workplaces, leveraging automation, AI-enabled tools, and best practices to improve service delivery.
 This is a hybrid role based in Bucharest , requiring 2-3 days per week onsite , with occasional travel to other company locations as required.
 Key Responsibilities 
Administer and support Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra ID, Active Directory, and endpoint management solutions.
Provide advanced technical support for hardware, software, operating systems, business applications, and collaboration platforms.
Manage user lifecycle activities including onboarding, offboarding, access management, and device provisioning.
Support Windows 10/11 environments, patching activities, endpoint compliance, and security controls.
Administer and support Intune and Windows Autopilot environments.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical incidents while ensuring service levels are met.
Perform root cause analysis and implement long-term corrective solutions.
Support office infrastructure, networking, and workplace technology environments.
Contribute to IT operations, security initiatives, system improvements, and technology projects.
Develop and maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, and operational procedures.
Partner closely with local stakeholders and global IT teams to ensure a consistent support experience.
Identify opportunities for automation, AI adoption, and operational efficiency improvements.
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Delivery 
95%+ SLA compliance for incidents and service requests.
Resolution time performance against agreed targets.
High-quality ticket documentation and knowledge management.
Successful onboarding and offboarding execution.
 Systems Reliability 
Endpoint compliance and device health metrics.
User account administration accuracy.
Infrastructure and workplace technology availability.
Security and patch management compliance.
 Continuous Improvement 
Reduction in recurring incidents.
Automation and process optimization contributions.
Documentation quality and knowledge sharing.
Participation in technology improvement initiatives.
 Experience 
End-user satisfaction scores.
Stakeholder feedback.
Effective communication and technical guidance.
Professional and customer-focused service delivery.
 Responsibilities 
4+ years of experience in Systems Administration, IT Operations, Technical Support, Infrastructure Support, or similar IT environments.
Strong hands-on experience supporting Microsoft-based enterprise environments.
Experience administering Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint.
Experience managing Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID environments.
Practical experience with Microsoft Intune and endpoint management.
Strong experience supporting Windows 10 and Windows 11 environments.
Experience managing user accounts, permissions, device provisioning, and access controls.
Proven ability to troubleshoot complex technical incidents across hardware, software, networking, and applications.
Experience working with ticketing systems and SLA-driven support processes.
Strong root cause analysis and problem-solving capabilities.
Experience supporting both traditional infrastructure and modern cloud-based environments.
Ability to leverage automation and AI-enabled tools to improve support efficiency and operational effectiveness.
Experience working directly with business stakeholders and end users.
Excellent English communication skills.
 Qualifications 
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred.
Strong customer-service orientation.
Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong documentation and organizational skills.
Valid passport and willingness to travel internationally as required.
 Preferred Certifications 
Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert (MS-102)
Microsoft Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)
Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
CompTIA A+
Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)
